name: express
$comment: This product has no required dependencies, by its own policy: express's
CLAUDE.md says the library is intentionally standalone and GTest must
stay optional. Both CMake guards agree -- tests/ builds express_unittest
only `if(GTEST_FOUND)`, and benchmarks/ finds benchmark CONFIG QUIET and
skips the target when it is absent. So both are features, not entries in
`dependencies`. In a composed build the consumer's own gtest satisfies
the test target anyway, which is why express_unittest is in the ninja
graph today without express asking for anything.
